issues.title: CS-013: Claim coverage with live conflict detection
issues.body:

Workflow: Todo → In Progress → Your review → Done after explicit approval and merge.

Acceptance criteria:
- [x] Open board checks assigned shifts and other pending claims for true interval overlap; touching boundaries are allowed, including overnight/DST cases.
- [x] Clicking claim/check shows an immediate no-page-reload warning from the current schedule snapshot; a fresh server preflight independently rechecks eligibility/conflicts before confirmation.
- [x] Confirm claim atomically rechecks current worker/business, request revision/status, future start, ownership and conflicts, then sets claimant from session and status pending.
- [x] Original worker remains assigned until manager approval (CS-014).
- [x] Concurrent claims on one request yield exactly one claimant; overlapping requests claimed by one worker cannot both succeed.
- [x] Own, foreign, expired, cancelled, approved and already-claimed requests are rejected; tampered identity/status fields are refused.
- [x] Worker can see pending claims in My requests; original owner and manager see updated pending status.
- [x] Session/Origin/JSON/CSRF, current account and query-scope protections apply to check/claim.
- [x] Loading, confirmation/cancel, stale/error/retry, keyboard/mobile states and tests/local preview provided.
- [x] User approval before push/merge.

Depends on CS-012 (#25, PR #26). Pending claims reserve time for subsequent claim checks; they do not transfer assignments. Manager approval/rejection and broader history remain CS-014/015.

Ready for Your review locally. Validation: all 80 tests pass; nine claiming tests rerun with exact-boundary adjacency also pass; syntax and diff checks pass. Browser verified immediate assigned/pending overlap warnings, fresh preflight, successful pending claim and My requests visibility, Keep browsing/focus restoration, stale final rejection after owner cancellation, and 390px mobile confirmation. merged_prs.title: CS-009: Manager shift creation and assignment
merged_prs.body:
Managers can create shifts from Schedule and assign workers within their business. Business-local dates are converted to UTC, including overnight shifts, with server-side calendar/DST validation and atomic overlap prevention. Saved shifts appear in manager and worker views.

Validation: 50 passing tests, JavaScript syntax checks, git diff --check, and desktop/mobile browser checks of creation, persisted schedule, worker visibility and overlap feedback. User reviewed the manager preview and explicitly approved push and merge.

Closes #19

merged_prs.title: CS-008: Worker management and secure account setup
merged_prs.body:
Managers can view their own business roster and add workers by name and email. Workers choose their own password through a single-use, 24-hour setup link; managers can replace pending links. Setup tokens are stored hashed and consumed atomically, with backward-compatible JSON schema support.

Validation: 43 passing tests, JavaScript syntax checks, git diff --check, and local browser checks of add-worker, roster, and setup landing page. User reviewed the local preview and explicitly approved push and merge.

Closes #17

merged_prs.title: CS-007: saved manager dashboard and milestone walkthrough
merged_prs.body:
Connects manager Overview, Schedule, and read-only Approvals to saved business records. Shows worker/shift/claim counts, assigned workers, original workers and claimants, business-timezone dates, and warnings for unresolved claims on completed shifts. Reuses safe shift cards across roles and adds refresh/empty/error/retry states. Approval/rejection controls remain disabled until their planned increment.

Validation: syntax checks, diff checks, and all 36 tests passed. Browser verified both roles, mobile layout, saved refresh/reload, empty panels, retry/recovery, role denial, and disabled actions using isolated data. Adds the milestone walkthrough document. Runtime data is excluded from Git.

User reviewed the populated local preview and explicitly requested merge.

Closes #13

merged_prs.title: CS-006: assigned upcoming worker shifts
merged_prs.body:
Connects the worker My shifts page to saved JSON records. The server derives worker/business identity from the session, includes current and future assigned shifts, excludes completed shifts, and orders results by start time. Adds business-timezone dates, overnight/DST formatting, refresh, and honest loading/empty/error/retry states. No shift mutations or coverage actions are added.

Validation: syntax checks and all 30 tests passed. Browser verified saved updates after Refresh/reload, current/overnight rows, empty results, recovery after unreadable isolated storage, and mobile layout. Normal user data was unchanged and runtime files are excluded from Git.

User reviewed the local preview and explicitly requested merge.

Closes #11

merged_prs.title: CS-005: session login and protected workspaces
merged_prs.body:
Adds responsive login, logout, expiring opaque server-side sessions, role-specific protected workspaces, and business-scoped account context. Signup accounts can sign in using their existing hashes. Logout requires the session CSRF token and same-origin JSON. The public role-switching demo is separate at /demo and grants no account access. Includes explicit development-only demo account setup and HTTPS cookie/origin configuration.

Validation: syntax checks and all 24 tests passed, covering passwords, session rotation and expiry, CSRF/logout, role/business isolation, and existing signup/storage behavior. Browser checked both roles, invalid credentials, refresh, logout, role denial, demo isolation, signup-to-login, and 390px layout with isolated data. Runtime account records are excluded from Git.

User reviewed the local preview and explicitly requested merge. Sessions are single-server/in-memory and reset on restart. Saved shift views remain CS-006.

Closes #9

merged_prs.title: CS-004: manager signup and business creation
merged_prs.body:
Adds a responsive signup page that atomically saves a new business and its manager account. Server validates inputs, rejects duplicate emails and client-selected roles/business IDs, and stores salted scrypt password hashes. Includes accessible error/success states, a demo-workspace signup link, same-origin JSON request checks, request size/rate limits, and updated Todo-first task tracking.

Validation: syntax checks and all 15 signup/storage tests passed. Browser checked blank-field errors, password visibility, successful signup, duplicate email, keyboard access, and 390px layout using isolated data. Runtime account records remain excluded from Git.

User reviewed locally and explicitly requested merge. Login, sessions, and protected access remain CS-005.

Closes #7

merged_prs.title: CS-003: validated persistent JSON storage
merged_prs.body:
Adds a versioned JSON model for businesses, users, shifts, and coverage requests; serialized transactions with atomic file replacement; business-scoped read repositories; and non-destructive fictional seed and inspection commands. Server startup validates or initializes private storage. Runtime records remain ignored by Git and unavailable through HTTP.

Validation: syntax checks and all nine storage tests passed, covering restart persistence, concurrent updates, rollback, corrupt files, writer locks, complete reads, and cross-business references. HTTP checks confirmed the app loads and private data paths return 404. User approved publishing and merging.

Deployment: one server instance with persistent local disk. Signup/authentication and connecting the demo UI to records remain subsequent tasks.

Closes #5

merged_prs.title: CS-002: responsive worker and manager navigation
merged_prs.body:
Adds seven responsive worker and manager preview screens, active navigation, role preview switching, and public CSS/JS assets. Demo data is labeled and future actions are disabled. Records the agreed issue/board/review workflow.

Validation: JavaScript syntax, HTTP assets/404/405, all seven screens, direct-link refresh, keyboard skip link, and phone layout checked. User approved the preview and explicitly requested merge.

Closes #3

merged_prs.title: CS-001: establish project foundation
merged_prs.body:
Adds the approved Node server and start page, setup instructions, data ignore rules, and task/review documentation. Preserves existing repository history and Node ignore rules.

Validation: syntax check passed; local preview returned 200 for the start page and 404 for an unknown path. User reviewed CS-001, approved it, and explicitly requested merging.

Closes #2
